Hi Serge and Artem, please forward the individual three-line enquiries below to these 20 accounts through your verified event/AutoLab contacts and copy me on replies: 1c1jp5dhwy, aaronatlan, ashleychenyj, claudiagaes, claudioolmedo, cloud-post-code, connorbuchheit, ebaenamar, extraton618, fkaita, flaviabeppler, frido22, hl728, n0rang2, sasap91, solal24, thomasoh0408, vyahhi, wilsonwu-ai, yavol.
